meta.title: Implement HTTP connection pooling for WxPayServiceApacheHttpImpl
meta.body_summary: Add HTTP connection pooling via Apache HttpClient's PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager to WxPayServiceApacheHttpImpl, with separate SSL/non‑SSL pools, configurable max connections, and automatic reuse of pooled clients to eliminate per‑request HttpClient creation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot introduced connection pooling with no performance measurement; PR received zero human review and was closed without merge after ~5 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 507 changed lines over 7 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume. As a performance improvement adding connection pooling, it is a moderate change that was closed without merge, likely due to lack of review activity rather than technical rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review, comment, or formal review recorded in the dataset.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding HTTP connection pooling eliminates per‑request HttpClient creation overhead, enabling connection reuse and better resource management for high‑concurrency payment workflows.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without merge after remaining unreviewed for ~5 days; no explicit rejection reason was communicated.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR introduced a medium‑sized infrastructure change but received zero human review, likely because the maintainer did not engage with the Copilot‑generated PR; closure suggests a process boundary where unsolicited PRs may be ignored.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, repro steps, or review comments to validate performance claims.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager in WxPayConfig with separate pools for SSL and non‑SSL clients; updated WxPayServiceApacheHttpImpl to reuse pooled clients instead of building a new CloseableHttpClient per request; added initHttpClient/initSslHttpClient methods and tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The last two files contain an unrelated variable naming fix committed by binarywang before the connection pooling work; the connection pooling implementation is confined to the config, service impl, and test files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit by binarywang: unrelated variable naming fix in refund notification classes.
Copilot implements connection pooling: PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager added to WxPayConfig, service impl switched to pooled clients, and connection pool unit test.
Follow‑up commit enhances SSL support, adds CONNECTION_POOL.md documentation and usage example test.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by Copilot with connection pooling implementation.
No human reviews or comments received; PR remained in ready‑for‑review state after Copilot work.
PR eventually closed without merge (no explicit close event in dataset, but status is closed).
